name: 99019 · Liberty Lake, WA
findings: ZIP 99019 (Liberty Lake) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99019 (Liberty Lake) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 7 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
